issue_context.title: Logbook Uptime entrys changed to 1970
issue_context.body:
**The problem**

Please check this post in the community forum:
https://community.home-assistant.io/t/logbook-uptime-entrys-changed-to-1970/278598



**What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?**

core-2021.2.3
supervisor-2021.02.9
Home Assistant 2021.2.3

**What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?**

Not 100% but I think it was the latest 2020 Version

**What type of installation are you running?**

Home Assistant Supervised on the Ondroid  N2+ (blue)

**Integration causing the issue**

Ubiquiti UniFi

**Link to integration documentation on our website**

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/unifi/

**Example YAML snippet**

```yaml
# Put your YAML below this line
no yaml
```


**Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?**


![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11904931/107952510-24eb9e00-6f9a-11eb-94f7-fce6e92ee709.png)
![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11904931/107952584-3d5bb880-6f9a-11eb-87c6-a480d098d89e.png)

**what version of the controller are you running?**

the newest 6.0.45 

**did an update of the controller cause this issue?**

nope

**how is the controller hosted?**

rasberry pi 3+
comments:
Hello

Some information is lacking here;

1. what version of hass was it last working on?
2. what version of the controller are you running?
3. did an update of the controller cause this issue?
4. how is the controller hosted?

Its poor form to refer to a forum thread rather than putting the effort into creating a proper issue, it doesn't take many minutes or thought to make sure the proper information gets posted.
I edited the answers in the text above :)

@Kane610 
I can confirm that https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/unifi/sensor.py#L145 is returning a timestamp (0 + uptime), but I guess it should be something like `utc_timestamp_now - self.client.uptime`.
Not sure if the uptime output was changed in Unifi OS or there was a change in HA.

I was wondering why it was like that, but only started to use the integration yesterday.

Using the latest versions and I think it is probably easy to fix, but have not yet started to code with the framework otherwise I would provide a PR 😉

I hope the information helps to fix this nasty bug soon.

Please make sure to update to the latest Home Assistant version and check if that solves the issue. Let us know if that works for you by adding a comment 👍
This issue has now been marked as stale and will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.
